items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: Yeah, I played with Billy Newberger and Shorty Reese before either one of them were married.

ctx.x: You know, Billy Newberger is over there now in Texas in San Antonio. I don't know where he is. Well, I see his son occasionally. I know his son better. His son comes back to work once in a while in New Orleans.
Yeah, I played with Billy Newberger and Shorty Reese before either one of them were married.
